# UI text test fonts

The fixtures are unmodified fonts distributed under their accompanying SIL Open Font License 1.1 notices.

- ABeeZee Regular supplies a Latin face. [Pinned Google Fonts source](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/5026800714d07231937d92eb4cceabf06e05d74e/ofl/abeezee).
- PT Serif Regular and Bold supply Cyrillic fallback and an alternate weight. [Pinned Google Fonts source](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/5026800714d07231937d92eb4cceabf06e05d74e/ofl/ptserif).
- Source Code Pro Regular supplies a CFF OpenType face. [Pinned Adobe source](https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-code-pro/tree/803b7e23ec97ae58b6232ea76519a76d428ba268/OTF).
